objective1.dial: They knew we were coming! Defend yourself!

objective2.dial: The General has scattered powerful code fragments across the city. We must secure them before the other factions do.

objective3.description: Eliminate the guards blocking the path

objective4.dial: The General's property is not for you.

objective5.dial: You have it. Now, who are you giving it to? The Machines, or Zion?
